question: Find the name and age of the visitor who bought the most tickets at once.
reference_sql: SELECT t1.name ,  t1.age FROM visitor AS t1 JOIN visit AS t2 ON t1.id  =  t2.visitor_id ORDER BY t2.num_of_ticket DESC LIMIT 1

final.sql:
